notes.W7154454518: Across ~219,000 people in five cohorts, later-born generations both start old age with better memory and decline more slowly. That double dividend is large enough to explain the ~13% per-decade fall in dementia incidence. Observational, but a formal bounding analysis tests period assumptions.
notes.W7110625727: A cross-randomised trial in 415 Kenyan villages: an 80-minute aspirations workshop raised labour supply, investment and living standards 17 months later versus a placebo workshop. Cash transfers raised aspirations too, suggesting a psychological channel inside economic aid. Replication outside Kenya is the obvious test.
notes.W7236198088: Ferroptotic cancer cells leak Ca2+ through peroxidised membranes, which switches on p38 MAPK and PGE2 production that disables cDC1 dendritic cells. The immune-suppressing signal is separable from cell death, so it could be blocked while keeping the killing. Mouse models so far.
notes.W7127973727: Uses conditional mutual information inequalities to derive non-perturbative rules for open, nonequilibrium systems: the CMI scaling exponent cannot increase along RG flow, and symmetry-broken phases survive symmetry-breaking noise. It imports an information-theoretic c-theorem logic into dissipative matter, though some results rest on stated assumptions.
notes.W7163878680: A 3.95-billion-year-old gneiss from North China formed by melting basaltic crust at >1.6 GPa along a cool gradient, unlike the low-pressure Acasta rocks. That implies rapid burial of altered ocean crust, a transient subduction event in the Hadean. One locality, so 'transient' is the honest word.
notes.W7235945204: Surveying 24 taxa and ~40,000 species from forest to oil palm in Indonesia, monocultures lost ~78% of landscape multidiversity, yet communities did not homogenise: turnover gave way to nestedness. This scale-aware view suggests remnant agroforests can still lift regional diversity.
notes.W7169530300: Shows that at stabilizer states, the curvature of stabilizer Rényi entropy (magic) equals quantum Fisher information, linking computational and metrological resources. Exact solutions give finite magic density with vanishing entanglement, so the two resources can be fully decoupled in simulable dynamics.
notes.W4407884439: Thousands of reaching trials over weeks, not the usual few hundred, reveal near-complete adaptation, rising retention and spontaneous recovery, and narrowing generalisation. Standard short protocols may misdescribe how motor memories mature, relevant to rehabilitation. Samples are small (10 and 18 participants).
notes.W7128466625: A 1.29-gram flapping-wing robot hovers and tracks trajectories with only onboard IMU, optical flow, time-of-flight sensing and a microcontroller, reaching centimetre accuracy outside a motion-capture room. It removes the tether to external tracking that has confined insect-scale flight; power is still offboard.
notes.W7235880957: A map of what stands between record-setting perovskite cells and deployment: scalable solution processing, packaging, field reliability and economics. Useful because the bottleneck has shifted from efficiency to stability and manufacture, and this review organises that new problem.

thread: The dementia cohorts and the Kenyan aspirations trial make the same structural point from opposite ends: population trajectories that look fixed are malleable. Lifetime environment shifted both the starting level and slope of cognitive ageing, while a short workshop and cash shifted the slope of household investment. In both, the lever acts on the trajectory, not a single endpoint.

notes.W4416048293: Shifts: Huang and Yang's 1957 low-density Fermi gas energy formula was a physicist's prediction → it is now a theorem, with matching upper and lower bounds. Universality via the scattering length alone is proven, not assumed.
notes.W7220376616: Shifts: Onsager regression and Green-Kubo relations held only near thermal equilibrium → a generalised linear response links steady-state fluctuations to transport in active fluids with memory. Living matter gains a fluctuation-response foundation without projection operators.
notes.W4403797072: Shifts: sine-kernel universality was established case by case under sufficient conditions → it holds if and only if the spectral measure has a unique Lebesgue tangent measure at the point. Universality becomes a local geometric property of the measure.
notes.W4411174673: Shifts: genotype-phenotype maps were treated as fixed backgrounds for evolution → the maps themselves evolve to maximise the number of genotypes yielding fit phenotypes. Regulatory architecture parameters become predictable from an optimisation principle, without full mechanistic detail.

foundation.title: What you see depends on scale
foundation.principle: Many quantities have no fixed value; they flow as the observation window changes, and the flow itself is the real object. In the CMI paper, correlations between regions are tracked as length scale grows, and the constraint is on how the exponent may change along the RG flow. In tropical landscapes, monocultures look devastating locally yet show differentiation rather than homogenisation regionally, so alpha and gamma diversity tell different stories. In motor learning, weeks of training reveal retention and generalisation that a few hundred trials hide. In dementia, comparing birth cohorts rather than ages exposes a slope change invisible in cross-sections. The same logic governs turbulence, epidemiology and finance: choose the window deliberately, and report how the answer changes across windows.
rests_on: Wilson (1971). Renormalization Group and Critical Phenomena
Levin (1992). The Problem of Pattern and Scale in Ecology
foundation.question: Can biological and social systems be given an RG-like theory that predicts which observables are scale-invariant and which flow, before data are collected?

W7154454518.question: Is falling dementia incidence due to higher starting cognition, slower decline, or both?
W7154454518.approach: Analysed ~783,000 episodic memory tests from ~219,000 people across five longitudinal cohorts, comparing birth cohorts.
W7154454518.finding: Later cohorts start higher and decline slower; projected 20-year advantage at 80 could explain 13% per-decade incidence drop.
W7154454518.implication: Lifespan environment reshapes cognitive ageing itself, not only reserve at its start.

W7110625727.question: Do higher aspirations drive long-term investment among people living in poverty?
W7110625727.approach: 415-village field experiment, 8,300 Kenyan women; aspirations workshop cross-randomised with large unconditional cash transfers.
W7110625727.finding: Workshop raised aspirations, labour supply, investment, revenue and living standards at 17 months; cash also raised aspirations.
W7110625727.implication: Aspirations are a policy-relevant lever that responds to both psychological and economic interventions.

W7236198088.question: Why do ferroptotic cancer cells blunt the anticancer immune response?
W7236198088.approach: Oxylipin profiling and signalling dissection in ferroptotic cancer cells and mouse tumour models.
W7236198088.finding: Membrane permeabilisation lets Ca2+ in, activating p38 MAPK and PGE2, which impairs cDC1 priming of CD8+ T cells.
W7236198088.implication: Blocking this axis could keep ferroptotic killing while restoring immunity.

W7127973727.question: What general rules constrain RG flows and phase stability in nonequilibrium systems?
W7127973727.approach: Quantum information inequalities on conditional mutual information between separated regions.
W7127973727.finding: CMI scaling exponent cannot increase along RG flow; symmetry-broken states are perturbatively stable to symmetry-breaking channels.
W7127973727.implication: Gives non-perturbative, model-independent constraints for decoherent and driven matter.

W7163878680.question: When and how did subduction-like processes begin on early Earth?
W7163878680.approach: Zircon U-Pb, oxygen and hafnium isotopes plus thermodynamic and trace-element modelling of a new North China gneiss.
W7163878680.finding: 3.95 Ga rock formed by 8–16% melting of basalt at >1.6 GPa, 740–820 °C, from Hadean depleted mantle.
W7163878680.implication: Points to transient subduction of altered oceanic crust before 3.9 billion years ago.

W7235945204.question: How does tropical land-use intensification restructure biodiversity across space and taxa?
W7235945204.approach: Ecosystem-wide survey of 24 taxonomic groups, 40,049 species, from forest to rubber and oil palm in Indonesia.
W7235945204.finding: Monocultures lost ~78% landscape and ~50% local multidiversity; no consistent homogenisation, but a turnover-to-nestedness shift.
W7235945204.implication: Conserving traditional agroforest remnants could partly offset regional diversity losses.

W7169530300.question: How are magic and entanglement related in many-body quantum dynamics?
W7169530300.approach: Analytic geometry of stabilizer Rényi entropy, Clifford pruning on forest graphs, exact solution of Ising and kicked chains.
W7169530300.finding: Magic curvature equals quantum Fisher information; finite magic density with vanishing entanglement density is achievable.
W7169530300.implication: Magic and entanglement can be engineered independently, linking computation and metrology resources.

W4407884439.question: How does a motor memory develop over thousands of trials and weeks?
W4407884439.approach: Force-field reaching adaptation over 9 sessions in two experiments (n = 10, n = 18).
W4407884439.finding: Near-complete compensation, long-term gains in retention and spontaneous recovery, and narrowing angular generalisation.
W4407884439.implication: Short laboratory protocols may misrepresent mature motor learning, with consequences for rehabilitation design.

W7128466625.question: Can an insect-scale aerial robot fly stably using only onboard sensing and computation?
W7128466625.approach: Integrated IMU, optical flow, time-of-flight sensors, estimators and controllers on a 1.29 g flapping-wing robot.
W7128466625.finding: Centimetre-scale hover and tracking; 30-second flight outside motion capture avoided obstacles and landed on a sunflower.
W7128466625.implication: Frees microrobots from motion-capture rooms; onboard planning and power autonomy are next.

W7235880957.question: What must change for perovskite photovoltaics to deploy at scale?
W7235880957.approach: Comprehensive review of solution and vapour processing, module packaging, field testing and economics.
W7235880957.finding: Efficiency is largely solved at small scale; scalability and real-world stability are now the roadblocks.
W7235880957.implication: Frames commercialisation research priorities around reliability and manufacturing rather than record efficiencies.

figure_notes.W7154454518: Memory level is plotted against age, with separate lines for each birth cohort over overlapping age ranges. Compare lines at the same age: higher lines for later-born cohorts show better starting memory, and flatter slopes show slower decline, the two parts of the double dividend.
figure_notes.W7236198088: Panel a profiles oxylipins in several cancer cell lines after RSL3 induces ferroptosis. Look for PGE2 rising consistently across lines compared with DMSO controls; later panels link that PGE2 to dysfunctional cDC1 dendritic cells, making it the immune-escape signal.
figure_notes.W7127973727: The system is cut into three regions: A and C of equal size separated by a slab B of width l_B. Conditional mutual information measures A–C correlations not carried through B; the constraints describe how this decays as the slab widens. Panels b and c show alternative geometries.
figure_notes.W7163878680: Cathodoluminescence images show internal zoning of zircon grains with analysis spots marked, alongside SHRIMP U–Pb concordia data. Oscillatory zoning indicates magmatic growth, and clustering of concordant points near 3.95 Ga dates crystallisation of the gneiss's parent magma.
figure_notes.W7235945204: Panel a lays out the gradient: lowland forest, jungle rubber agroforest, then rubber and oil palm monocultures. Panel b lists the 24 aboveground and belowground taxa surveyed. Read subsequent panels left to right as intensification increases and track how local and landscape diversity fall.
figure_notes.W4407884439: Kinematic error for right-hand reaches is plotted across nine training sessions. Error starts high when the counterclockwise force field appears and shrinks toward zero; how close it gets, and how quickly it returns after breaks, shows compensation and retention improving over weeks.
figure_notes.W7128466625: Panel A shows the robot landing on a sunflower; B the bare robot; C the three circuit boards carrying IMU, microcontroller, and optical flow plus time-of-flight sensors. D–E show the integrated 1.29 g robot from above and below, and F compares lift to justify the larger module.
